plugins.name: docks
plugins.description: Engineering skill kit of agentskills.io skills. Sequential pipeline skills — security audit (OWASP Top 10), refactor (dead code, duplication, SOLID), and skill-agent-pipeline — plus portable convention skills: test-first, coverage, fix workflows, code review, design tokens, dependency-vuln triage, lint discipline, UI polish, SOLID, type-safety, and React component patterns. Routes plan approval to the companion plan-lifecycle plugin.

plugins.name: plan-lifecycle
plugins.description: GitHub-issue plan lifecycle with marker-based plan bodies, a normalizing helper, comment-backed review records, implement-start linked branches, 10-round plan and code review loops whose continuation the user authorizes or delegates, two read-only reviewer agents, and an explicit-only yolo skill that runs the whole lifecycle and asks only before merge.
